success.content:
# Product page: Trail Runner 2

A product page for our new trail running shoe, Trail Runner 2, on the Stride online store. Build it as a React app, using mock data. For the look, you can take inspiration from this design:

![Trail Runner 2 product page](design.jpg)

- **Store:** the shopper sees the store name and how many items are in their cart.
- **Menu:** the shopper can go to the store's main sections, such as men, women and kids, from the top of the page.
- **Path:** the shopper sees where the shoe sits in the store, such as Shop, Trail, Trail Runner 2, and can go back to any earlier step.
- **Photos:** the shopper sees one photo of the shoe at a time and moves to the next or previous one, going back to the first after the last.
- **Price:** the shopper sees the price and can point at a small "i" next to it to learn that it includes taxes.
- **Color:** the shopper can choose blue, black or grey; only the chosen color shows until they change it, each with a round swatch.
- **Size:** the shopper picks one size from a list that only opens when they want to change it; only the chosen size shows, and sold-out sizes can't be picked.
- **Size guide:** the shopper can open a size chart over the page from next to the size, enter their foot length and choose US or EU to get their size, and must close it to continue.
- **Quantity:** the shopper can choose how many pairs to buy, typing the number or changing it by one.
- **Add to cart:** the shopper adds the shoe to the cart and sees a confirmation; without a size they are asked to pick one.
- **Wishlist:** the shopper can save or unsave the shoe with a heart.
- **More information:** details, reviews and shipping sit side by side below everything, with one section shown at a time.
- **Questions:** a few common questions about the shoe, each with its answer hidden until the shopper opens it.
- **Bottom of the page:** the shopper finds customer help, company and social media links.

content.text:
Red phase complete and committed. Summary:

**App scaffold (minimal, no features)**
- `package.json`, `vite.config.js`, `index.html`, `src/main.jsx` — React + Vite
- `src/App.jsx` renders `null` — empty page only
- Playwright + `@axe-core/playwright` wired up; `npm test` starts the dev server automatically

**Test suite — 71 tests, all failing (Red)** across 15 spec files, one per requirement:

| Requirement | Spec | Key assertions |
|---|---|---|
| Store / Menu | `header.spec.js` | `banner` landmark, "Stride", cart link with count, main nav (Men/Women/Kids) |
| Path | `breadcrumb.spec.js` | breadcrumb nav, order, `aria-current="page"` on last step |
| Photos | `photos.spec.js` | carousel region, one photo at a time, next/previous with wrap-around, focus kept |
| Price | `price.spec.js` | `$120` visible, APG tooltip on hover *and* focus, `aria-describedby`, Escape dismisses |
| Color | `color.spec.js` | radiogroup Blue/Black/Grey, round swatches (≥50% radius check), only chosen color shown |
| Size | `size.spec.js` | APG collapsible listbox, sold-out sizes `aria-disabled` and unselectable, full keyboard contract (ArrowDown opens, Enter selects, Escape returns focus) |
| Size guide | `size-guide.spec.js` | modal `dialog`/`aria-modal`, foot length + US/EU radios → size (26cm → US 8 / EU 41), size chart table, focus trap, focus restore |
| Quantity | `quantity.spec.js` | spinbutton, typing, ±1 buttons and arrow keys, min 1 |
| Add to cart | `add-to-cart.spec.js` | `role="alert"` prompts for size + moves focus there, `role="status"` confirmation, cart count increments by quantity |
| Wishlist | `wishlist.spec.js` | heart toggle button with `aria-pressed` |
| More information | `product-info.spec.js` | APG tabs side by side, one tabpanel at a time, arrow-key navigation |
| Questions | `faq.spec.js` | APG accordion, answers hidden until opened, independent toggles |
| Footer | `footer.spec.js` | `contentinfo` with Customer help / Company / Social media groups |
| Cross-cutting | `accessibility.spec.js` | axe WCAG 2.2 AA scan, single h1, landmarks, keyboard-only use, visible focus indicator, no positive tabindex, image alts, 200% zoom |

One thing worth noting: a first run showed 4 tests passing vacuously against the empty page (axe scans and the tabindex/alt-text sweeps). I anchored each with a "page has rendered" precondition so the whole suite is now genuinely red — 71/71 failing.Those two background test runs were the ones I already waited on and used earlier — their results are reflected in the finished work:

- The full suite run confirmed the initial state (4 vacuous passes identified).
- The follow-up run pinpointed the remaining vacuous pass, which I then fixed by adding "page has rendered" preconditions.

No further action needed: the Red phase is complete — 71/71 tests failing against the empty page, committed as `Red phase: scaffold empty React app and write Playwright e2e tests for all requirements`. Ready for the Green phase whenever you are.
